neighbours.label: advice to do first-hand research before choosing (visit past work, talk to owners, find out what the client wants), as against the same nouns in plain narrative
fire: Before choosing a roofer, look at roofs they have repaired and speak to the homeowners.
Ask the agency for past projects, then call those clients and ask how it went.
Before you buy a used car, inspect it in daylight and talk to the previous owner.
Tour several nurseries, watch how the staff behave and chat with other parents.
When picking a landscaper, visit gardens they have planted and meet the owners.
Our designers first listen to clients to learn what they need from the kitchen.
Before signing a lease, walk the building at night and talk to current tenants.
Interview a few architects, visit buildings they have designed and ask the occupants.
quiet: The roofer repaired our roof in March and the homeowners were pleased.
The agency finished three projects last year for clients in the city.
My uncle bought a used car last week from the previous owner.
The nursery staff took the children to the park on Friday.
The landscaper planted the garden while the owners were away.
Our designers built the kitchen in only four weeks.
The building was quiet at night and the tenants were asleep.
The architect designed a building that won a national prize.
